candidates.description: This feature activates on words, roots, and subword tokens related to robots, automation, and android technology.
This vector is related to common German auxiliary, modal, and copula verbs across various tenses and conjugations.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing or starting with the root sequence "autom".
This vector activates for German nouns related to work, labor, and abstract concepts, alongside their inflectional suffixes.
This vector represents computer software, programming, and digital systems.
These tokens represent German modal verbs and their inflected forms expressing necessity, ability, or volition.
This feature vector represents concepts related to transportation, automotive vehicles, mobile devices, and telecommunications technology.
This vector represents technical terminology and related Germanic root words.
This feature vector represents common German action verbs in their base and present-tense forms.
These tokens are German verb stems, prefixes, and adjective roots commonly used in formal, technical, or business contexts for describing actions, features, and processes.
